name: YouTube Transcript
description: Fetches the transcript/captions of a YouTube video by URL or ID, returning the full text. Lets a content agent study a video's actual content, summarize it, or repurpose it.

tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.description: Get the transcript text of a YouTube video from its URL or 11-character video ID. Returns the concatenated caption text. Best-effort: some videos have captions disabled or region-locked.

video.description: A YouTube watch URL, youtu.be URL, or the 11-char video ID.

lang.description: Optional preferred caption language code (e.g. 'en'). Falls back to whatever's available.
